verdict.rationale: RunAnywhere documents a tool-calling loop and a voice-agent that 'listens, thinks, and answers out loud' via natural-language input (runanywhere-docs-1, runanywhere-docs-26), which is the core mechanism for NL-command operation. But hands-on community testing found this concretely broken: a user said 'navigate to google.com in safari' and nothing happened, yet the assistant reported success, which another commenter confirms is a known tool-calling failure mode for small models rather than an edge case. Missing for 10: reliable execution of NL commands verified independently, and no vendor acknowledgment/fix of the grounding failure.
